description: A regular SMTP-to-HTTP bridge (same shape as `smtp-to-notification`/`smtp-to-msg`) whose receiver is the platform's own API gateway route for `http-to-sink`, which forwards on to the sink test receiver. Exists purely as infrastructure for the post-deploy gateway smoke test (unitysvc-k8s gateway-smoke workflow): it proves the SMTP gateway can reach the API gateway end to end — SMTP gateway -> API gateway (`http-to-sink`) -> sink -- verifiable by polling sink's own `/retrieve` API. Uses `auth_mode: forward` (the SMTP gateway's own mechanism, see plugins/lib/email_to_http.js in smtp-gateway — replays the caller's own svcpass as a Bearer token) rather than the API-gateway-side `api_key: __forward__` disposition, which requires a statically-resolvable literal host and would reject the `${API_GATEWAY_BASE_URL}` placeholder needed for this to work correctly on both staging and production. Not intended for real relay use.
name: smtp-to-apisix-gateway
summary: Gateway smoke-test only: SMTP gateway -> API gateway (http-to-sink) -> sink, fixed and unauthenticated except for the forwarded caller credential.
